classificationPolicy: Do not infer a language distribution tier from alphabet, country, population guesses, or availability of fonts. Assign only from a cited population/usage dataset with a documented threshold.
countingPolicy: Distinct family identity only; no weights, styles, subsets, file formats, mirrors or duplicate provider records.
statusPolicy: Dead/historical languages require cited vitality evidence. Unknown status remains unknown.
unmetTargetPolicy: Report actual verified families and numeric gap. Never fabricate or duplicate families to meet target.
